Heap snapshot diff after 20 symbol switches

items.value: ran 20 times; chart.destroy() ran each time

question: Which line keeps every old chart alive?

explanation.cause: bind() at unmount makes a new function, so removeEventListener removes nothing
explanation.why: removeEventListener removes only the exact function that was added. The constructor stored a bound handleTick and componentDidMount added that one; calling .bind(this) again creates a different function, so the removal is a silent no-op. The feed keeps every unmounted chart reachable and calls it on each tick. Pass this.handleTick as is.
explanation.tell: Instances grow by one per switch though unmount and destroy() run every time, and the feed’s tick listeners retain them: the cleanup runs, but its removal matches nothing.
